latestUserIntent: Use internet data and start training when lawful access is available; custom/professional user capture cannot be supplied. Prior wait-for-first-party-only assumption superseded.

candidate.siteFamily: Universidad de los Andes Salsa academy (paper Appendix8.8)
candidate.oneChoreography: Published beginner choreography; exact task_id plus choreography version must be confirmed from licensed metadata

supervision.primary: Original human expert whole-take numeric rating from per-expert data.json, same rater and same choreography only
supervision.target: Research-only relative execution-quality predictor within that exact rater/choreography; not dance-step correctness or app mastery
notTargets: Whisper transcript as verbatim expert truth
Missing commentary as a bad-execution label
Unverified ASR/translation/LLM text as expert label
Auto pose/pseudo-GT as physical contact/weight or human correctness

admissionGates: Human licensee reviews final agreements and intended commercial derivative scope; keeps executed contract receipt privately; no raw product-video/music redistribution inferred.
Approved metadata confirms exact single choreography, solo/multi-person status, exo is_ego=false, frame alignment, rater scores and source/capture/participant aliases.
Build connected components across global authorized metadata by participant aliases OR capture/source recording OR byte-identical source; never split components or camera angles.
Find at least12 independent components/participants with at least2 eligible takes each, and same-rater numeric target variation in train/validation; availability is unknown.
If a capture connects participants, keep the whole connected component together; if12 useful components cannot be formed, report insufficiency rather than random-frame split.
Pick one comparable full-body non-overhead external view per take from metadata/view quality; selection cannot use performance label or held-out result.
Resolve exact per-file transfer and sizes before download. --views exo may include all exo cameras; do not assume it selects one. No unconditional/default/all download.
Core single owner accepts external-license provenance sidecar and purpose mapping; do not mislabel external assets as user-created first-party consent.

proposedBoundsOnly.ifExceeded: Stop and report, no automatic budget/scope increase. Bounds are proposals for later coordinator approval.

split.unit: Connected participant/capture/source component; all takes and all views in one partition
split.officialSplits: Honor sealed official test, do not request hidden benchmark labels. Freeze eligible train/val source universe and custom internal holdout before training; do not report official benchmark scores. If official partitions conflict with grouping, exclude conflicted groups.
split.sharedChoreographyAndSong: Intentional single-task restriction; no unseen-song/choreography/site/device generalization claim. No audio features inP0.
split.testMarker: Reuse shared Core test-open receipt, single owner; no repeated tuning after holdout

model.features: Small predefined normalized2D pose/velocity/missingness whole-take summary; no raw RGB, audio, face or identity features
model.head: CPU regularized linear/ridge research head; train-only scaling and median imputation
model.hyperparameterSelection: Predeclared small regularization grid using validation only; choose/report once
baselines: Nearest reference sequence/DTW if a valid train-only reference exists, separately labelled diagnostic

evaluation.level: Whole take and participant component; never frame-independent accuracy
metrics: Per-rater rank correlation where score variation permits
Group-bootstrap uncertainty and per-participant failure/missing-pose coverage
Same-score tie handling and camera/visibility quality strata
evaluation.success: Pipeline runs on licensed genuine labels and leakage checks pass; measured gain is evidence for another research phase only. No achieved threshold or product acceptance asserted.
evaluation.ifScoresMissing: Stop supervised fitting; optional later authorized decode/feature IO sanity is not training or model accuracy.

coreAdapterRequest.action: Review existing capture intake plus an external-license provenance sidecar; no new pipeline in this app
sidecarFields: label origin:human expert vs ASR vs pseudo

productBoundary.shippingDemonstrationCatalog: EMPTY remains; dataset training license is not raw demonstration/music distribution permission
productBoundary.inAppUnsupportedStates: Remain until task-specific independent calibration/device acceptance and a reviewed app update

excludedSources.AISTplusplus: AnnotationsCC BY4.0 distinct from academic-research AIST raw video/music terms; no blanket commercial corpus use; excluded fromP0
excludedSources.HDance: Conflicting source/rights information; no use this turn

humanNextStep.action: User personally chooses correct licensee in official portal, supplies own fields and reviews/submits/signs final HelloSign agreements if acceptable; no model-agent signature or application submission
humanNextStep.fee: Official getting-started says no dataset fee; no spend now
humanNextStep.risks: Legally binding agreement plus private contact/address transmission; user handles these directly. Raw video/audio and participant identities cannot be republished by assumption.
humanNextStep.afterApproval: User keeps emailed temporary credentials in secure local storage; never posts them to chat/repo; coordinator confirms exact bounded metadata/download scope first
